proposed_fixes.title: Correct an unintended browser activation veto if reproduced
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Quick Accent's foreground-app exclusion/activation path rejects the browser gesture, or the browser context prevents the hook from observing the same key sequence that works in an ordinary text editor. The report does not yet establish a faulty exclusion cache or a hook failure.
plan: Reproduce the author's exact browser/control and compare the already-confirmed A-plus-Space gesture in Notepad with the same configured activation mode.
Check configured exclusions and privilege context before editing code; a browser intentionally excluded by configuration needs guidance rather than a patch.

If an unintended veto remains, trace src/modules/poweraccent/PowerAccentKeyboardService/KeyboardListener.cpp foreground/exclusion caching and OnKeyDown to identify the precise rejected event or stale decision.

Correct only the demonstrated decision/cache lifecycle and add regression coverage for foreground changes and excluded versus allowed applications without bypassing integrity or browser security boundaries.
verification: In the named browser control and Notepad, the same supported gesture must activate in allowed applications under the same privilege context.
An explicitly excluded browser must remain excluded.
Switch between excluded and allowed foreground applications and verify no stale exclusion decision leaks across windows.

confidence.rationale: The repeated-letter observation points to non-activation, but the exact environment is missing and a settings-only explanation remains credible.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that you already hold A and press Space, but only more A characters appear. That answers the earlier invocation question; the next step is to isolate the different browser environment.

1. Please provide your installed PowerToys version (General settings), browser name/version, and whether the failure is in the address bar or an ordinary page text box. Please avoid private content.
2. Could you confirm whether that same gesture works in Notepad? Please also name the configured Quick Accent activation method, any matching excluded-app entry, and whether the browser or PowerToys runs as administrator. Share only browser-relevant exclusions, not your whole application list.

This comparison distinguishes a browser-wide activation veto from a particular input control or privilege difference.

actions.label: Approve scoped browser-activation investigation
actions.note: Low-confidence hypothesis; reproduce the allowed-browser case before changing a hook or exclusion decision.
